subject: Pilot payment corridor: conditional Net45, credit guardrails, and VAT evidence
messages:
From: Mike Riggs <mike.riggs@aurorahealth.com>
To: laura.bennett@redwood.inference.com, payments@aurorahealth.com
Cc: Susan Chen <susan.chen@aurorahealth.com>
Date: 2026-11-09T09:12:00-08:00
Subject: Pilot payment corridor / Net45 request and VAT evidence

Hi Laura,

Thanks for the demos last week — the team is excited to pilot Redwood for our care-coordination workflows. Procurement asked me to surface the following commercial asks so we can keep our internal SOW/PO timeline on track: 

- Can we run the 90-day pilot on Net45 (instead of Net30) for the initial ramp period?
- Aurora will provide a PO (PO-43721) as an anchor.
- We can provide VAT/ tax residency evidence but need detail on what Redwood requires to support reclaim in our AP flow.
- Would Redwood consider a short-term credit buffer ($100k) for the pilot to avoid delayed product access?

Timing: procurement needs approval by EOD next Wednesday to hit month-end onboarding. Happy to jump on a quick call if helpful.

Thanks,
Mike Riggs
Director, Procurement — Aurora Health
payments@aurorahealth.com

[attachment: PO-43721.pdf (stub)]

From: laura.bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.inference.com>
To: Mike Riggs <mike.riggs@aurorahealth.com>
Cc: rishi.malhotra@redwood.inference.com, karthik_iyer@redwood.inference.com
Date: 2026-11-09T14:28:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Pilot payment corridor / Net45 request and VAT evidence

Mike — thanks, and congrats to the team on the green light from product. Quick response with the commercial path I can offer from Redwood: 

1) Conditional Net45 for first 90 days: we can approve Net45 for the pilot if Aurora provides:
   • A PO anchor (you already sent PO-43721 — thanks)
   • VAT/residency evidence for reclaim (see checklist attached)

2) Credit buffer: we can provision an initial credit corridor of $75,000 to start. After two consecutive, on-time invoice cycles we can uplift to $150,000 subject to the credit guardrails below.

3) Guardrails / triggers:
   • Auto-escalation: uplift to $150k after two clean cycles.
   • Invoice holdback: if >1 late payment (>15 days) within 60 days, revert to prepay for 30 days.
   • Billing contact: please confirm AP contact and ACH details for remittance.

Attached: SOW-draft.pdf (commercial stub) and VAT-evidence-checklist.xlsx with the minimum docs our finance team needs. 

If that framework works, I’ll loop in Rishi to confirm the credit matrix and draft an amendment to your SOW/PO. We can also put a short-term escrow clause if procurement prefers.

I’m available for a 20-minute call tomorrow afternoon to finalize.

Best,
Laura Bennett
Head of Revenue Operations
Redwood Inference
laura.bennett@redwood.inference.com
+1 415-555-0182

[attachments: SOW-draft.pdf (stub), VAT-evidence-checklist.xlsx]

From: Mike Riggs <mike.riggs@aurorahealth.com>
To: laura.bennett@redwood.inference.com
Cc: Susan Chen <susan.chen@aurorahealth.com>, payments@aurorahealth.com
Date: 2026-11-10T10:03:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Pilot payment corridor / Net45 request and VAT evidence

Laura — appreciate the fast turnaround and the draft guardrails. A couple clarifications from procurement and AP: 

- PO-43721 is confirmed and finance will route an e-invoice against it. I attached the PO for your records.
- VAT evidence: Aurora can provide our EU VAT registration and certificate; we may need Redwood’s VAT registration for any reverse-charge support — can you confirm what you will send back?
- The initial $75k corridor is fine as long as increases are automated after two clean cycles. Procurement has asked if Redwood can add an automated notification to the invoice reminder flow when the corridor hits 75% utilization.

We want to avoid manual escalation mid-pilot. We can do the call tomorrow at 3pm PST.

Thanks,
Mike

[attachment: PO-43721.pdf (stub)]

From: rishi.malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.inference.com>
To: laura.bennett@redwood.inference.com, Mike Riggs <mike.riggs@aurorahealth.com>
Cc: karthik_iyer@redwood.inference.com
Date: 2026-11-11T08:15:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Pilot payment corridor / Net45 request and VAT evidence

Thanks — looping in Finance specifics so we have operational clarity. Notes from my side: 

1) Credit matrix (attached): we will provision $75,000 credit on day zero tied to PO-43721. Conditions:
   - Two consecutive invoices paid within Net45 -> automatic uplift to $150,000.
   - Any invoice >15 days overdue will trigger a temporary holdback and require a short-term prepay for 30 days.

2) Monitoring / alerts: we can add a utilization webhook and invoice-utilization email to payments@aurorahealth.com and your AP contact. That will generate an automated notification at 75% and 90% utilization thresholds.

3) VAT / tax handling: for EU VAT reclaim we need:
   - Aurora VAT certificate (country-specific).
   - Redwood VAT registration number (we will provide a single EU registration string; if multiple entities required we will map per invoice).
   - Preferred reclaim flow: Aurora should charge reverse-charge where applicable; otherwise we will apply VAT and provide a tax invoice to support reclaim.

4) Escrow option: if procurement requires, we can include a 30-day escrow clause to be released on milestones — examples in the SOW addendum.

Next steps: Laura, if you confirm we will generate a short amendment for PO-43721 and circulate for signature (DocuSign).

Rishi Malhotra
Head of Finance Operations
Redwood Inference
rishi.malhotra@redwood.inference.com

[attachment: credit_matrix.csv (stub)]

From: laura.bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.inference.com>
To: Mike Riggs <mike.riggs@aurorahealth.com>
Cc: rishi.malhotra@redwood.inference.com, karthik_iyer@redwood.inference.com
Date: 2026-11-16T17:42:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Pilot payment corridor / Net45 request and VAT evidence — mutual action plan

Mike / Susan — thanks for the call today and for confirming the PO. To put this in writing, here's the mutual action plan we discussed: 

1) Documents to exchange by EOD Mon 11/17:
   - Aurora: VAT certificate (EU) and AP contact + ACH details (payments@aurorahealth.com).
   - Redwood: EU VAT registration string and short SOW addendum (we’ll attach to PO-43721).

2) Commercial terms (pilot):
   - Net45 for first 90 days; invoices issued against PO-43721.
   - Initial credit corridor: $75,000, auto-uplift to $150,000 after two consecutive on-time payments within Net45.
   - Utilization alerts at 75% / 90% to payments@aurorahealth.com (automated).
   - Holdback trigger: any invoice >15 days overdue -> 30-day prepay requirement.

3) Operational steps:
   - Redwood to issue amendment and DocuSign link by 11/18. (link circulated after internal approvals).
   - Aurora to send VAT docs and AP details by 11/17 to avoid onboarding delay.

If that captures everything, I’ll route the amendment to DocuSign and Rishi will sign off on the credit matrix. Once signed we’ll flip the pilot to active and schedule billing for the following invoice period.

Appreciate the partnership — we’ll keep the process light to avoid onboarding friction.

Best,
Laura
Head of Revenue Operations
Redwood Inference

[DocuSign: will send embedded signing link]
